verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say AI agents can interact with Drata to "automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language," and an official Drata MCP setup guide is documented. Natural-language operation therefore exists, but only through an external AI agent connected via MCP, and the evidence is limited to page titles and a one-line claim. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations are reachable by natural language and with what limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Enable AI agents to interact with Drata. Automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language.
